messages.subject: Re: Account Setup on shiny.apps.io hangs
parts: I'm having a login problem, and while attempting to fix I was forced into the account-setup process.  I noticed that if you type in the name of your currently-exiting account in the account-setup box, then the Save button shifts to a slightly lighter blue, and when you push the Save button nothing happens.  Could it be that the hang is due to the machine having detected that the name is already in use?

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Account Setup on shiny.apps.io hangs
parts:
Some account names a reserved for use by shinyapps.io for internal use. Currently, no accounts names can begin with the following words:

https://gist.github.com/kippandrew/fa38883251265579a330

However, we may make this less restrictive at some point. 

In the mean time, I fixed the bug where the error message when a name was rejected was not being displayed.

-Andy
